case.title: Only the first answer differs from the other seven: no fire

submissions.open_text: Queue at the communal point is short before seven
Children carry containers home after school

case.why: This probes an off-by-one at the start of the array. An implementation that compares answers[1..7] against answers[1], starting its loop at index 1 and using the wrong reference, would see seven 5s and fire. The index-0 answer of 4 must break the run, so it stays silent. Quiet checks: as a participant, 420 s is at least 180 s. same_spot never applies to participants. The texts share no content words. There is no voice note. 08:20 and 17:45 are inside working hours. There is a single contributor on the device. There are only 2 submissions. Both points are inside Kondele.
